title: Symbol-U Assistant Utility — Scenario
description: A frozen test conversation with its preregistered concern routing. The scenario set is authored and hash-frozen BEFORE any arm runs; concern IDs and expected bridge output may NOT change during the primary analysis.

user_message.description: the user's turn(s); the only thing every arm receives

frozen_concern_ids.description: concern IDs from concern_ontology_v1 (0 = NO_APPLICABLE_CONCERN scenario)

rationale.description: why these concern IDs (from ordinary meaning; no varna reasoning)

expected_bridge_output.description: the deterministic bridge result for the frozen concern IDs (ground-truth path used by arms C/D)

category.description: the ontology parent category the scenario primarily exercises
